scope: Isolated product-bound synthetic SQLite and fixed spreadsheet API verification. No release or platform-wide acceptance.

baseline.setup: Export the committed index with git checkout-index into a new temporary directory and copy only the candidate regression file into it.

finalAffectedSelection.command: WORKSPACE_HTTP_TESTS=1 node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/panel-read-snapshot.test.cjs tests/panel-store.test.cjs tests/panel-api.test.cjs tests/panel-xlsx.test.cjs tests/panel-mutation-recovery.test.cjs tests/data-lifecycle.test.cjs tests/lifecycle-api.test.cjs tests/prelaunch-concurrency.test.cjs tests/product-backup.test.cjs

newCases.name: panel detail keeps source links and review state in one snapshot during a committed source deletion
panel CSV exports a complete saved revision when source deletion commits during the read
panel XLSX exports the complete source-linked snapshot instead of rejecting mixed revisions
panel project deletion cannot combine deleted sources with an earlier saved project response
panel source upload cannot appear under the revision read before its commit
panel reads preserve an existing outer read transaction and its snapshot
panel read failures end only their own snapshot without writes or a stale subsequent read

accounting.explanation: All seven new cases are included in the final 191. The earlier focused run, earlier affected run with two default-disabled HTTP cases, and separately enabled two-case HTTP run overlap and are not additional distinct cases.

defect.readBoundary: Project row/revision and source metadata were fetched in separate autocommit queries.
reproducedOutcomes: Source deletion produced a reviewed row whose source ID was absent from the returned sources.
CSV exported that reviewed row with its source filename missing.
XLSX rejected the mixed saved state with xlsx_invalid_data.
Whole-project deletion and source upload could also mix the earlier project row with later source metadata.
defect.fix: Own one deferred read transaction when no transaction exists. Reuse and leave any caller transaction unchanged.

peerReview.result: No concrete defect found in transaction ownership, failure cleanup or coordinated SQLite test hook.

remainingLimits: Complete integrated-source regression and committed-source CI remain required.
Filesystem path replacement/tampering was not established by this SQL repair.
No Windows native execution, real Excel, physical-device, native OCR isolation or selected-host durability acceptance.
